title: Chunking a paired bit string
statement: Let $c$ and $w$ be finite Boolean words and let $N$ be a natural number. Suppose $|w|=N|c|$ and either $|c|>0$ or $N=0$. Then applying the chunking operation to the encoding of $c$ paired with $w$ yields the encoding of the list of $N$ consecutive chunks of $w$, each of length $|c|$, beginning at positions $0,|c|,\ldots,(N-1)|c|$.
